privacy.metaDescription: How Atomic IT Sp. z o.o. processes personal data on atomic-it.site.
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.lead: We take your data seriously. Below is a clear summary of who the controller is, what we collect, and why.

controller.title: 1. Data controller
paragraphs: The controller is Atomic IT Sp. z o.o., ul. Gospodarcza 24 lok. 25, 20-213 Lublin, Poland, NIP 9462749033, REGON 540612452, KRS 0001147827.
Data protection contact: info{'@'}atomic-it.site.

data.title: 2. What data we collect
paragraphs: Via the contact form: email address and the website type related to your enquiry.
Technical data needed to run the site: interface language, cookie consent settings, basic server logs.
If you consent: analytics data (Microsoft Clarity) and marketing data (Google Ads) — see the cookie policy.

purposes.title: 3. Purposes and legal bases
paragraphs: Replying to enquiries and preparing quotes — Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (pre-contractual steps) or (f) (legitimate interest).
Business correspondence related to your enquiry — Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR.
Analytics and marketing — only with consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR), which you may withdraw at any time.
Form data is kept as long as needed to handle the enquiry, then for the limitation period of claims where required by law.

cookies.title: 4. Cookies and third-party tools
paragraphs: We use necessary cookies (e.g. language) and — after consent — analytics and marketing cookies.
Third parties: Microsoft Clarity (behaviour analytics) and Google (Google Ads). Data may be transferred outside the EEA under SCCs or other GDPR-compliant safeguards.

rights.title: 5. Your rights
paragraphs: You have the right of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability, and objection to processing based on legitimate interest.
You may withdraw consent at any time without affecting the lawfulness of processing before withdrawal.
You may lodge a complaint with the Polish DPA (UODO) or your local supervisory authority.

contact.title: 6. Contact
paragraphs: For privacy questions, email info{'@'}atomic-it.site or contact us via WhatsApp using the number on the website.

cookies.metaDescription: Which cookies Atomic IT uses and how to manage consent.
cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.lead: Short version: necessary cookies always run. Analytics and marketing load only after your consent.
cookies.manageText: You can change your decision at any time. After you choose, the site loads scripts according to your consent.
cookies.statusAccepted: Current: analytics and/or marketing cookies accepted.

banner.title: Cookies on this site
banner.text: We use necessary cookies to run the site. Analytics (Clarity) and marketing (Google Ads) load only after consent.

what.title: 1. What cookies are
paragraphs: Cookies are small files stored in your browser. They remember settings, help us understand how the site works, or measure ad performance.
On atomic-it.site we distinguish necessary cookies from optional analytics and marketing cookies.

types.title: 2. Cookies we use
paragraphs: Necessary: site language (i18n) and your consent choice. The site needs these to work properly.
Analytics (after consent): Microsoft Clarity — session recordings and heatmaps to improve usability.
Marketing (after consent): Google Ads (gtag) — conversion tracking and campaign measurement.

manage.title: 3. Managing consent
paragraphs: On your first visit we show a banner. You can accept all cookies or stick to necessary ones.
You can also change your choice on this page or clear local site data (localStorage) for atomic-it.site.

third.title: 4. Third-party providers
paragraphs: Microsoft Clarity: clarity.microsoft.com — Microsoft privacy policy.
Google Ads / Google Ireland Limited — Google ads and cookie policies.
Contact form delivery uses Resend; enquiry content is sent to info{'@'}atomic-it.site.
